document_type.description: The type of the document, which can vary freely.

content_type.description: The content-type of the generated output. The template engine needs to support this.

template_engine.description: The identifier of the template engine the user would like to use.

template_engine_options.description: Optional configuration options for processing the document. Can vary freely.

parameters.description: Optional parameters which are tied to the template. Can vary freely.

metadata.description: Optional metadata tied to the generated document. Can vary freely. In the example of PDF's, the following keys can be used to set specific PDF parameters: title, author, subject, keywords, reator, producer, creationDate, modDate
